decisions.reason: As a specialized B2B lighting product with sunk development costs and likely long sales cycles, management is inclined to retain it and explain any weak results as temporary demand timing rather than failure.

This product received its own page and a follow-on LED replacement launch, signaling visible commitment and strategic fit with the firm's industrial lighting business, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
Because it was publicly relaunched as a popular designer task light, management has both reputational and investment reasons to continue backing it rather than admit the relaunch underperformed.

Although office lighting demand may have been unsettled, the firm has already publicly introduced the product and can attribute disappointing performance to temporary market conditions, supporting continuation.
The premium positioning makes it somewhat more exposed to weak demand, but the firm has still invested in launch visibility and is likely to persist for now rather than reverse course quickly.
